subject: Compliance-driven hosting qualification — next steps and MAP
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
To: Anita Shah <anita.shah@medpoint.health>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2027 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Compliance-driven hosting qualification — next steps and MAP

Hi Anita —

Great to speak earlier. Quick recap and a suggested mutual action plan so we stay audit-ready and keep your timeline moving. Main points from our call:

- Auditor asks: BAA required + SOC2 Type II evidence, and a strong preference for customer-side key control / private VPC for PHI processing.
- Business need: production inference for clinician decision-support (low-latency, predictable throughput), likely ~4–6k requests/day initially.

Redwood-hosting options (short):
1) Hosted API (with BAA): fast to market; we can sign a BAA and provide SOC2 report. Shared tenancy but logical isolation; supports customer-managed keys via bring-your-own-KMS for some controls. May not satisfy auditors insisting on network isolation.
2) Dedicated capacity (reserved GPUs): single-tenant GPU pool, predictable throughput and capacity commitment. We can combine with private peering and BYO-KMS to meet many audit requirements while keeping Redwood managed.
3) Private (VPC / on-prem): customer-controlled VPC or on-prem appliance. Best for strong auditor requirements (network isolation, customer-controlled keys, air-gapped designs). Longer procurement and ops lead time.

Immediate next steps I propose (MAP):
- You confirm must-have vs nice-to-have (e.g., is customer-managed KMS mandatory or preferred?).
- I’ll share: 1) draft BAA redline, 2) SOC2 snapshot, 3) an example network diagram showing Dedicated + private peering + BYO-KMS. (attached: MP-BAA-draft-v1.pdf, SOC2-snapshot-2026.pdf)
- If auditor will accept Dedicated + BYO-KMS + private peering, we can target a pilot in 3–4 weeks. If they require Private VPC/on-prem, we’ll need procurement & security to align for a longer timeline.

Can we schedule a 30-min follow-up with your security lead and procurement next week? I’m available Wed/Thu afternoons.

Thanks —

Jordan Blake
Enterprise Solutions
Redwood Inference
